name: Chaoz Implosion
author: Elvii
description: Right before the cube portal, Click on the slope to skip the cube portal at 47%. Then from 48%-50% you'll have to navigate through the following gameplay respectively (preferably like in the video) until at 51.0% where you'll need to time a slope jump (there's an invisible slope that lets you go higher) after you hit the cube portal and fall onto the slope structure to hit the toggle orb to make an invisible saw disappear. Then after that buffer 3 clicks from 51.6% to than 53.0% where from there you'll have to time the blue orb late to fall out of the level. Stay at the floor until the end
